requirement: The owner account is pre-registered when the service initializes.
label: INFERRED
evidence:
@app.before_first_request
def init_db(): ... owner = users_collection().find_one({"username": OWNER_USERNAME}); if owner is None: users_collection().insert_one({"username": OWNER_USERNAME, "password": hash_password(OWNER_PASSWORD), "privileged": True}) ... ; also in __main__: init_db() before app.run(...)
